name: lever reverse grip lateral pulldown
description: A reverse grip lat pulldown on a machine. Builds the lats and biceps.
instructions: Adjust the seat so your knees fit under the pads and sit down.
Grip the handles with your palms facing you, arms straight.
Pull the handles down toward your upper chest, driving your elbows down.
Squeeze your back at the bottom.
Let the handles rise slowly until your arms are straight.
